summary: #634 budget UX: get_budget_snapshot + format markdown; gh plate autonomy --budget [--estimate-tokens]; plate_autonomy_budget MCP; feature_loop start auto-hydrates remaining tokens from durable spend when autonomy enabled (use_live_budget default true).
migration_impact: New CLI flag --budget and MCP plate_autonomy_budget. Feature loop start may block when live budget pressure + estimate exceed rails (only when .plate autonomy enabled and risk != off). Explicit budget_remaining still wins; use_live_budget=false opts out.
migration_guidance: 2. Inspect rails: gh plate autonomy --budget [--estimate-tokens N] --json or plate_autonomy_budget.
3. Feature loop start without --budget-remaining hydrates from spend.json when autonomy is on.
4. Pass --budget-remaining or use_live_budget=false for isolated/test starts.
agent_notes: Prefer plate_autonomy_budget before long feature_loop starts. risk-off repos see snapshot limits but do not auto-block starts. Pairs with durable spend (#634) and cost dashboard (#653).
